report_name: Macro Representation and Policy Probability Audit
task_scope: Static source audit plus offline forward/statistics on the saved 300-state trace. No rollout, task realization, environment execution, Matching, KKT, Exact-Q, training, optimizer update, or checkpoint/config write.

source_paths_and_functions.logic: The per-realization observation spec takes vehicle_ids from the first training-origin scenario. Each aligned origin must match that exact ID/order. Each valid horizon is keyed by vehicle_id and emitted in the observation-spec order; invalid horizons are empty and zero-filled in the observation. Cross-realization compatibility checks vehicle-slot count but not vehicle ID tuple equality, so per-episode first-origin orders may differ while tensor shape remains valid.

Builds the shared formal observation, Cache candidate list and UAV STAY+MOVE candidate features. The rollout uses active selected Cache for the Micro observation and sequential UAV0 then UAV1 conditioning.
Cache target proposal enumeration/selection used by the Macro candidate builder.

Applies legal masks, subtracts log group candidate counts, then forms categorical probabilities. Cache index 0 is KEEP and all nonzero candidates form UPDATE; Micro feature group bits distinguish STAY/MOVE. Duration is a conditional masked categorical given selected Cache candidate.
Enumerates legal MOVE targets without environment execution and applies each selected target to the in-memory autoregressive trial state.

symbols: evaluate_pool (247; policy_action_mode validation at 263; collection at 320-325)
source_paths_and_functions.logic: The formal evaluator selects deterministic or stochastic collection through the deterministic flag.
Formal training calls collect_dual_timescale_episode with deterministic=False before the PPO update.

code_audit.VEHICLE_SELECTION_RULE: For each realization, take the vehicle_ids vector from the first formal training-origin scenario when constructing ConfigurationObservationSpec; there is no per-origin distance ranking or active-set reselection.
code_audit.VEHICLE_ORDER_RULE: Use the stored vehicle_ids vector order (not sorted); observation packing looks up each horizon dict by that fixed ID tuple.
code_audit.missing_vehicle_behavior: A missing ID in a valid origin/horizon fails alignment. There is no per-vehicle padding or replacement. An invalid terminal horizon is zero-filled as a whole and marked by the horizon mask.
code_audit.formal_action_probability_path: masked categorical after group-balance; duration is conditional on Cache action; UAV1 is autoregressively conditioned on the selected UAV0 position. Cache and Micro rollout masks are all-true over generated candidates; candidate generators supply the legal candidate sets, and duration masks are all-true over configured durations.
code_audit.deterministic_selection_path: Cache/Micro select a group by summed categorical probability then choose by raw score within UPDATE/MOVE; duration selects the categorical argmax. This can make repeated group choices even when group probability is modest.

training_vs_evaluator.deterministic_evaluator: src/ppo_simple/evaluator.py evaluate_pool maps policy_action_mode='deterministic' to deterministic=True
training_vs_evaluator.stochastic_evaluator: src/ppo_simple/evaluator.py evaluate_pool maps policy_action_mode='stochastic' to deterministic=False

cache.flatten_order: node-major, then service id; C row-major

vehicle_predictions.flat_order: horizon-major, then observation_spec.vehicle_ids order, then x/y

horizon_validity_mask.invalid_horizon_behavior: zero-fill the entire horizon's vehicle and popularity block

vehicle_identity_audit.rate_definition: Across 25 slot indices, all C(5,2) episode pairs and origins 25/75/125; count unequal vehicle-id strings divided by total comparisons.
vehicle_identity_audit.interpretation: The raw flattened MLP vehicle coordinates use the same slot dimensions for different vehicle IDs across realizations; within each realization and across valid horizons, IDs remain aligned.

DYNAMIC_SLOT_REASSIGNMENT_SCOPE.between_realization_initializations: YES; each episode builds its vehicle slot tuple from its own first-origin artifact
DYNAMIC_SLOT_REASSIGNMENT_SCOPE.within_episode_vehicle_disappearance_or_: NO; the aligned path requires the same full ID tuple at every valid origin/horizon and errors on a missing ID

uav.probability_definition: Formal masked categorical after group balance; UAV1_P_STAY is marginalized over the formal UAV0 categorical distribution. Also retain deterministic-UAV0 conditional values per state.

probability_statistics.probability_collapse_rule: YES if at least 3 of 4 action families have max group/action probability >=0.90 on >=80% of states; PARTIAL if one or more but fewer than 3 meet that threshold; otherwise NO.
probability_statistics.deterministic_amplification_rule: YES if Cache group, duration, UAV0 group and UAV1 group are each >=95% one deterministic mode, and at least one selected-action median probability is 0.50-0.70.

target_scale_and_time_to_go_audit.time_to_go_insufficiency_rule: YES when median cross-episode return std across the five aligned origins is at least 2x conditional-noise median std and at least 3/5 origin ratios are >=2; NO when median is below the conditional-noise median; otherwise UNCLEAR.
